name: axon-pharma
description: A Streamlit + Firebase app that uses Gemini function calling to automate pharmacitical tasks for both Admin + Customers.

paragraphs: This is an app that allows admin to generate and post announcements to Telegram channels and groups, add medicines to the database, update stock, delete medicines, and update order status. It also allows users to search for medicines, view medicine details, get prices, place orders, view order status, and cancel orders. All done with a prompt to Gemini AI.
features: Login: Admin login with email and password.
Generate Announcement: Create and post pharmacy announcements to Telegram channel and group using Gemini AI.
Add Medicine: Add new medicine entries to the Firebase database.
Update Stock: Modify the stock quantity of existing medicines and notify users if a medicine is out of stock via Telegram.
Delete Medicine: Remove medicine entries from the database and send Telegram notifications.
